name: SONE
tagline: Native TIDAL client for Linux — modern UI, bit-perfect lossless FLAC and Hi-Res audio
blurb: SONE is a native, lightweight desktop client for TIDAL on Linux that pairs a modern, polished interface with bit-perfect, lossless Hi-Res audio — no compromise on either.
description:
SONE is a native, lightweight desktop client for TIDAL on Linux that pairs a
modern, polished interface with bit-perfect, lossless Hi-Res audio — no
compromise on either. Built with Tauri and Rust, it's small and fully native.
The interface is customizable to the core: a full-screen player with
karaoke-style synced lyrics, a floating miniplayer, and a theming engine that
derives a complete light or dark palette from any two colors.

It streams your library in lossless FLAC and Hi-Res quality up to
24-bit/192kHz, with gapless, silence-free playback. For bit-perfect output,
exclusive ALSA mode bypasses PulseAudio and PipeWire entirely, sending the
unaltered signal straight to your DAC — or use normal mode for casual
listening through your system's default output.

Audio

• Lossless FLAC and Hi-Res streaming up to 24-bit/192kHz

• Exclusive ALSA output — bypasses PulseAudio and PipeWire, sending bit-perfect audio straight to your DAC

• Bit-perfect mode with bit-depth promotion to your DAC's native depth

• Automatic DAC format and sample-rate detection, with graceful fallback on mismatches

• Channel negotiation and a stereo mix matrix for fixed-channel DACs

• Hot-swap DACs — the ALSA output re-initialises on device change, no restart needed

• Signal Path Transparency — inspect the live pipeline and confirm a pristine, bit-clean path to your DAC

• Gapless, silence-free playback

• Volume normalization (ReplayGain) with automatic album/track switching

Video

• Music video playback in a dedicated player — full-screen or minimized to the player bar, with HLS streaming that starts at your selected quality and adapts to your bandwidth (video audio is streamed, not the bit-perfect path)

• Videos and tracks share one queue, with shuffle, repeat, autoplay, and history across both

• Favorite videos, browse them in Loved Tracks/Videos tabs, add them to playlists, and find them in Explore and search

Interface and customization

• Modern, fully customizable light and dark themes

• 15 theme presets and a full color picker that derives a complete palette from any two colors

• Full-screen player with album art, a blurred backdrop, and auto-hiding controls

• Karaoke-style synced lyrics

• Floating, resizable miniplayer

• Tabbed home page that remembers your last view

• Optional custom title bar — toggle native window decorations

• Customizable in-app keyboard shortcuts

Library and playback

• Browse your library, playlists, albums, artists, and mixes

• Personalized home feed and full catalog search

• Playlist management — folders, create, rename, edit, reorder, and public/private toggle

• Sort tracks and favorites by date added, name, or artist

• Queue with append and persistence across restarts

• Track and mix radio

• Explicit-content filter

Integrations and system

• Scrobble to Last.fm, Libre.fm, and ListenBrainz with ISRC and MusicBrainz metadata

• Discord Rich Presence with album art and a customizable status

• MPRIS media controls with media-key, position, shuffle, repeat, and seek support

• System tray with single-instance focus

• Open and share tidal:// deep links for tracks, albums, playlists, artists, and mixes

• Keep Awake — prevents the screen from sleeping during playback on X11, Wayland, and D-Bus

• MCP server — external AI agents like Claude Code can search your library and control playback (off by default)

• OBS stream overlay — a built-in browser source shows the current track, album art, and a live progress bar in OBS and other streaming software, styled with your theme (off by default)

• Play reporting — finished plays are reported to TIDAL so Recently Played stays in sync (on by default)

• Proxy support — HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS5

• Sign in securely with PKCE inside the app

Unofficial client — requires an active TIDAL subscription. SONE is a
streaming client only and does not support offline downloads.
